selection_policy.blocked_data_policy: A scientifically important blocked protocol may remain in the design portfolio, but cannot execute until its source contract is proven.
selection_policy.stratum_rule: select exactly one operationally complete hypothesis per frozen stratum
selection_policy.within_stratum_tie_break: nonblocked, total score, PIT, falsifiability, power, CPU cost, estimand hash
